Title: Register a user from the landing page
Steps: 1. Open homepage. 2. Navigate to login/register. 3. Register a unique user.
Expected Result: Account registration completes and success message appears.

Title: Login an existing user from the auth screen
Steps: 1. Open auth page. 2. Enter valid email/password. 3. Submit login.
Expected Result: Session created and redirected to shop page.

Title: Search for a product on the storefront
Steps: 1. Open shop page. 2. Type product name or keyword in search field.
Expected Result: Matching product appears in the catalog.

Title: Add a product to cart
Preconditions: User is on shop page and product exists
Steps: 1. Search product. 2. Click Add to Cart for the item.
Expected Result: Cart count updates and product is in checkout flow.

Title: Complete checkout with valid payment details
Preconditions: User has an item in cart
Steps: 1. Open cart/checkout. 2. Review order. 3. Fill shipping address. 4. Fill card details. 5. Submit.
Expected Result: Order confirmation is shown and checkout completes.

Title: Verify order is stored after successful checkout
Steps: 1. Capture the registered email. 2. Query `orders` and `order_items` for that user. 3. Validate total and item data.
Expected Result: The order is persisted in the database with matching product/quantity.

Title: Reject checkout when insufficient stock exists
Steps: 1. Attempt to add or order more than available stock. 2. Try checkout.
Expected Result: System blocks the order and prevents checkout completion.

Title: Auth gating prevents restricted flows without login
Steps: 1. Try to open protected pages or checkout directly.
Expected Result: User is redirected or blocked from protected flow.

Title: Phase 4 smoke: end-to-end happy path
Preconditions: App running and app DB initialized
Steps: 1. Register. 2. Login. 3. Search. 4. Add to cart. 5. Checkout. 6. Verify database row.
